thread:
maya: Kicking off account wiring + VNet for new eu-central-3 inference cluster. Need network CIDRs, Shared VPC attachment, GPU SKU availability, and quota requests. TF PR is up but want platform verification before validation run.

jon: Which project and expected capacity? GPU type?

maya: project: rdinfr-eu3-prod, shared Vpc host: rdinfr-shared-host, network: rdinfr-eu3-net.
- pod_cidr: 10.40.0.0/16
- node_cidr: 10.41.0.0/20
- nat/subnet egress via nat-gw-eu3 in public-subnet (10.41.0.0/24)
- desired GPUs: H100 (primary), fallback A100, target peak nodes: 12 (8x H100 initially)

sree: Heads up — H100 quota/availability in eu-central-3 is spotty right now. I checked provider SKU list this morning. If we want guaranteed capacity we may need to request quota increase + placement group reservation.
- quick check CLI: `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --filter="name~'h100'" --zones=eu-central3-*`
- fallback plan: allow A100/80GB or regional fallback to eu-west-1 in the routing policy.

deploy-bot: Created infra PR #4872 -> refs/heads/infra/eu3-wire 
PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4872

jon: From networking side, confirm Shared VPC attachment flow: Service project `rdinfr-eu3-prod` should request `compute.networkUser` on subnets in `rdinfr-shared-host`. Also need tag policy and route export rules. We should include firewall rules: allow 9000-9999/TCP between clusters for management and 22/443 for ops.

ashley: Also call out KMS key provisioning and HSM access if this is for Private deployments. Customer keys need to exist in kms-eu3 and be granted to service account `svc-infra-deployer@rdinfr-eu3-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Add this to TF.

maya: TF PR includes subnets + peering + service account resource, but KMS/HSM is separate. Snippet I added: 
```hcl
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "pods" {
  name          = "rdinfr-eu3-pods"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.40.0.0/16"
  region        = "eu-central-3"
  network       = "projects/rdinfr-shared-host/global/networks/rdinfr-eu3-net"
  private_ip_google_access = true
}
```

jon: Nice. Validation checklist I want to run after apply: 
1) terraform plan & apply in staging project
2) confirm Shared VPC attachment and `compute.networkUser` binding
3) validate subnet IPs & no overlap (ipam)
4) confirm NAT egress works -> `curl -sS http://metadata.google.internal` from a test node
5) kube smoke: `kubectl get nodes -o wide`, `kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i nvidia` 
6) run a small GPU job (tensor perf) to ensure GPUs are visible and scheduler picks them up
7) confirm monitoring dashboards and alerts are wired (token-level cost, node GPU metrics)
8) postmortem run: cost estimate calc for sustained 12-node H100 fleet

sree: For quota requests: open ticket to cloud provider with SKU + region + project + start/end date. Example message: 
"Requesting 12 H100 GPUs (or 12 A100 fallback) in eu-central-3 for project rdinfr-eu3-prod. Will reserve capacity for 3 months. Contact: sree@redwood.com"

maya: Who owns the handoff and post-apply validation? I want to make sure platform doesn't drop this after TF apply.

jon: I'll take validation and initial smoke tests. Assign to me + @sre-oncall for monitoring config. Planning to run validation at 11:30 UTC tomorrow.

ashley: Quick reminder: update org policy/service perimeter if needed (VPC-SC) and ensure the host project `rdinfr-shared-host` is in the same perimeter or has proper access. Also tag resources with `cost-center` and `env=prod` for billing.

maya: Added checklist item to PR description and updated the runbook section `eng-infra/region-onboard.md`. Linking PR comments to runbook.

deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for branch infra/eu3-wire (plan OK).

sree: One more thing — for cost: rough back-of-envelope monthly cost for H100 reserved capacity + networking ~ $35k-$50k depending on sustained utilization. Add fallback routing policy to avoid surprise when capacity is constrained.

jon: Copy. I'll include fallback region mapping in the routing policy and document failover steps.

maya: Perfect. After validation, I'll schedule handoff call and mark ownership to `platform-capacity` for capacity ops. Thanks all :thumbsup:
